run_closed.label: Run with the tab closed

evidence.registered: registered while offline (waits for the network)
events_after_going_online_with_no_page_o: sync keeper-change clients=0 folder=[NotAllowedError: The request is not allowed by the user agent or the platform in the current context.] notify=[TypeError: Failed to execute 'showNotification' on 'ServiceWorkerRegistration': No notification permission has been granted for this origin.]

evidence.by_design: documented, not observed: Chromium fires periodicsync only for an installed web app, no more often than its engagement-based interval (about 12 hours); a 75 s headless window can't show it either way

evidence.why: Web Push is the one way to wake a worker on demand, and it needs two things this run doesn't use: a push server holding the subscription, and the browser vendor's push service in between (Chromium delivers pushes only through Firebase Cloud Messaging: a subscription's endpoint is FCM's, so no local server can stand in). The browser resolved no host but 127.0.0.1, so subscribe() got as far as shown and no push was sent: untried, needs a push server and Google's FCM

run_closed.evidence: after closing the tab: 0 worker events after a file change, 0 in 75 s; going online then gave ["sync keeper-change clients=0 folder=[NotAllowedError: The request is not allowed by the user agent or the platform in the current context.] notify=[TypeError: Failed to execute 'showNotification' on 'ServiceWorkerRegistration': No notification permission has been granted for this origin.]"]; Push untried (subscribe: Error: no answer in 20 s)
run_closed.summary: No code ran for a local file change or within a minute of closing; a Background Sync held while offline did run when the network came back (a network event, not a file change); Push untried (needs a push server and the vendor's push service)

evidence.why: Web Push is the one way to wake a worker on demand, and it needs two things this run doesn't use: a push server holding the subscription, and the browser vendor's push service in between (Chromium delivers pushes only through Firebase Cloud Messaging: a subscription's endpoint is FCM's, so no local server can stand in). The browser resolved no host but 127.0.0.1, so subscribe() got as far as shown and no push was sent: untried, needs a push server and Google's FCM

what_a_worker_could_do_when_woken: sync keeper-change clients=0 folder=[NotAllowedError: The request is not allowed by the user agent or the platform in the current context.] notify=[TypeError: Failed to execute 'showNotification' on 'ServiceWorkerRegistration': No notification permission has been granted for this origin.]
evidence.why: a worker may only show one while handling an event (push, sync, a click); a file change or a minute gave it none

notify_closed.summary: No notification for a file change or within a minute of closing: nothing woke the worker; when the network did, showNotification refused (TypeError: Failed to execute 'showNotification' on 'ServiceWorkerRegistration': No notification permission has been granted for this origin.); Push untried (needs a push server and the vendor's push service)
